decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the shift to the last reference video's script and keywords; no additional update or removal is required.
The existing message-83 MODIFY already records that the opening hook should follow and improve upon the last reference video, without making the other hook constraints obsolete.
The existing message-83 MODIFY fully captures use of the last reference video as the complete-video model and substitution of the client's product.
The existing message-83 MODIFY already captures the reference-based visual direction, and the prior realism criteria remain compatible with producing a better version.
Using the last reference video as the model does not change the explicit Hindi-only language constraints.
The reference-model decision does not change the specified Indian market or audience age range.
The source does not mention or necessarily change the requirement for an organically incorporated call to action.

Recreating the last reference and leaving prior creativity aside may supersede the earlier testimonial presentation, but the supplied evidence does not reveal the reference video's format or establish whether testimonial presentation remains required.
The instruction to produce the complete video does not change the existing count, duration, or aspect-ratio requirements.
Moving directly to a complete reference-based video may end the preview-first workflow, but the source does not explicitly cancel further previews or establish a safe replacement value.
Producing a better reference-based version remains compatible with, and does not modify, the conversion and CPL objectives.
The complete-video instruction remains consistent with the freelancer's existing responsibility for footage, voiceover, and script and does not change that responsibility.
